items.label: 10th Gen Intel Core i3 Processor
items.value: Powered by 10th Gen Intel Core i3 (turbo up to 3.9GHz) & 14nm low-power tech, this Windows 11 tablet offers instant, reliable responsiveness. Draft Office reports, join remote work video conferences, edit photos lightly, or stream Netflix/Prime Video—all lag-free. Preloaded with genuine Windows 11 Home, its intuitive interface supports fast boot & seamless multitasking, perfect for professionals, students & home users.

items.label: 8GB RAM & 256GB SSD
items.value: 8GB high-speed RAM outperforms traditional memory for faster data processing. Run multiple browser tabs, Excel, and communication apps (Slack/Zoom/Teams) simultaneously lag-free, doubling your work/study efficiency! 256GB large-capacity SSD stores thousands of HD photos, hundreds of documents & multiple HD movies. PCIe 3.0 x4/SATA SSD adaptive, supports up to 2TB SSD storage expansion.

items.label: HD IPS Touchscreen
items.value: 10.1-inch 1280×800 HD IPS touchscreen provides a wider viewing area for immersive movie watching, e-reading, and online learning. Anti-glare tech reduces reflections, ensuring clear visibility outdoors (park benches, café patios) or under bright lights. Included standable case supports up to 145° angle adjustment for hands-free video calls, cooking tutorials & movie nights.

items.label: Ultra-Thin Windows tablet
items.value: Integrated aluminum alloy body—only 10.1mm thin & 1.34lbs light—easily fits into backpacks, handbags or large pockets. Ideal for commuters (subway news browsing), business travelers (in-flight document reviews), and students (in-class note-taking). 2MP front & 5MP AF rear cameras deliver clear images for smooth video calls & daily photography.

items.label: WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3
items.value: Latest WiFi 6 offers faster speed & more stable signals than previous generations—no lag for large file downloads, online gaming, or 4K streaming. Paired with Bluetooth 5.3, it enables longer range, lower latency, and less power use when connecting headsets, mice, or keyboards. Micro HDMI and full-featured Type-C ports, supporting 4K video output.

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: Case with stand, Charger Set, Hi10 X2 Windows Tablet
